name: apply_patch
description: Apply localized edits from inline text or a patch file. Supports line replacement, patch envelopes, and unified diffs.

file_path.description: Absolute target path for a single-file unified diff when its headers do not identify the file. Ignored for `*** Begin Patch` envelopes; `path` is an alias.

patch.description: The inline edit. Use one format: (A) `*** Begin Patch` with `*** Replace in line: <absolute/path>` plus `anchor:`, `old:`, and `new:`; (B) a `*** Begin Patch` envelope with `*** Update File:`, `*** Add File:` (`+`-prefixed content), or bodyless `*** Delete File:` sections and `@@` hunks; or (C) a unified diff identified by `file_path`, `---`/`+++`, or `diff --git` headers. Multi-file unified diffs are split automatically; unified diffs cannot delete files. Copy source exactly without `read_file` line prefixes; context and removed lines must match, including indentation. Do not use Markdown fences, mix formats, or send a no-op. Limit: 8000 characters (`patch_file`: 64000). Split larger edits; batch hunks only with unique context, and patch repeated structures separately.

patch_file.description: Absolute path to a patch file, instead of `patch`. It must be session-temp or inside the current working directory. Mutually exclusive with `patch`; limit 64000 characters.
